texts.facts: The complaint in the present petitions is that, for violation of the provisions of this order, the respondent No.3 - Commissioner of Police and respondent No. 4 - Superintendent of Police or Police Officials are conducting raid in the business premises of the petitioners and seizing the articles prohibited by such order.
texts.arguments: The contention is that, such action is without jurisdiction and authority. According to the petitioners, the officers competent under the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, can only conduct such raid and seizure and to prosecute the persons found voilating the provisions of the order. 3] The question is covered by the decision of the Division Bench of this Court in the case of Ganesh 4 wp24.18+821.18.odt Pandurang Jadhao and anr vrs. State of Maharashtra and ors, reported in 2016 Cri.L.J. 2401.
